comparison_policy: Compare exact unittest method IDs across suites; batch numbers are not paired because candidate discovery adds test methods and shifts later batches.
Only complete parseable batch result.json files are counted. A discovered test or created batch without result.json is not completed, never a pass.
Subtest IDs remain separate failure records. A method with any failing subtest is counted as one failing method; methods in complete batches without exceptional status are inferred passed.

Initial progress snapshots were read while suites were running. This final report is bound to the completed baseline and candidate summary.json files and all completed batch result files; later rechecks remain separate.
Original suite failures are preserved. Separately logged rechecks after minimal test expectation migrations do not rewrite historical result.json or convert the suite to PASS.
Test results are code/contract evidence only; they are not image-pixel success or user-quality judgments.

The specifically authorized post-generation validator CLI file was repaired after the regression was confirmed. Generator, data, auditor, saved packs/cores/ledgers, golden files and holdouts were not edited during regression classification; the two test-expectation migrations and separate rechecks are recorded.
Final baseline and candidate summary.json outcomes remain authoritative for their original runs; later rechecks do not rewrite those totals.
The same test ID does not imply the same cause. Function AST, failure expression and subtest context are compared; routing cases also have direct baseline/current diagnostics for both match stages.
Do not interpret total failure/error records 45 versus 44 as an improvement rate: discovery sets, fixture validity, environment, policy contracts and the first failing assertion differ.

The five unchanged routing fixtures have newly failing advisory-list assertions after the agreed profession advisory policy change. They remain explicit; no blanket claim of zero new regressions is made.

The generator/data/auditor generation snapshot remains preserved. Only the validator CLI diagnostic boundary was repaired after generation; before/after validator hashes and rechecks are linked separately.
